name: Rupesh Tiwari
title: AWS Senior CSM | Bar Raiser Perspective | 4,000+ Leaders Coached
tagline: I've sat on both sides of the FAANG interview table. I know exactly what gets you in.
story: Here's the thing nobody tells you: Director and VP interviews aren't harder versions of engineer interviews. They're completely different games. The bar raisers aren't looking for better code. They're looking for signals you probably don't know exist.

I spent 20 years climbing from SDE to AWS Senior CSM. I've been the candidate sweating through system design. I've been the bar raiser deciding who gets in. That's why I know exactly where senior leaders go wrong, and exactly how to fix it.

4,000+ professionals coached. 85% offer rate. 50+ verified 5-star reviews. These aren't vanity metrics. They're proof that when you understand what bar raisers actually want, you stop guessing and start landing offers.
